text: Errors thrown by an application are sent to Honeybadger automatically once the client library is installed and configured
quote: Once our client library is installed and configured, errors thrown by your application are automatically sent to our API.

text: Identical errors are grouped together, and you can still step through each individual occurrence (notice)
quote: Honeybadger groups identical errors together. Using our navigation bar, you can still navigate between each individual occurrence (or notice, as we also call them) of the error.

text: Grouping can be customized by changing the error class, component, or stack trace, or by sending a custom fingerprint
quote: You can customize the grouping for each exception by changing the error class name, component, or stack trace—or by sending a custom fingerprint.

text: Error search has a query syntax that filters by text, class, tags, component, and action, including negation
quote: Example query: `john class:UserError -tag:wip -tag:pending component:"UsersController" action:'update'`.

text: Errors can be searched within a single project or across all projects, by type, location, and metadata
quote: find previously-occurred errors by type, location, meta-data and many other attributes. You can search for errors in a single project, or across all projects.

text: Search can be filtered to errors that occurred since the most recent deployment
quote:
`occurred.after:'last deploy'`

Errors that occurred since the most recent deployment

text: A query builder lets you construct search queries without much typing
quote: we’ve included a query builder that allows you to construct them without much typing.

text: You can describe the search you want in natural language instead of writing the query yourself
quote: You can search for errors without writing the query yourself. Click the lightbulb icon next to the search box to open the “Describe your search” panel, then describe what you want to find.

text: BadgerQL lets you select fields, filter event types, and perform aggregations and calculations over event data
quote: With it you can specify which fields you want to see, filter the kinds of events that should be returned, perform aggregations and calculations, and more.

text: Insights query results can be charted and added to dashboards that can be shared with your team
quote: The Insights UI also lets you chart the results of those queries and add those charts to dashboards that you can share with your team.

text: Any dashboard widget can be duplicated in one click and the copy edited
quote: You can now duplicate any dashboard widget in one click and edit the copy instead of starting from scratch.

text: Charts support fill on grouped charts, conditional aggregates, and improved rates and histograms
quote: The `fill` function now works on grouped charts. We’ve also added conditional aggregates and improved rates and histograms.

text: Errors, uptime checks, and check-ins from several projects can be shown account-wide
quote: Honeybadger can display information from several projects on an account-wide basis, including the following: Errors, Uptime Checks, Check-Ins

text: Deployment tracking records deploys, keeps a deploy history, and correlates code changes with errors
quote: Deployment tracking lets you record when your app is deployed, see a history of deployments, and correlate code changes with errors.

text: Unresolved errors are automatically marked resolved when a deploy is recorded, and the team can be notified
quote: Deployment tracking lets you record when your app is deployed, see a history of deployments, and correlate code changes with errors. When you deploy, Honeybadger can automatically resolve open errors and notify your team.

text: With GitHub or GitLab connected, deploy revisions link to a diff of what changed since the last deploy
quote: When GitHub or GitLab is connected, Honeybadger links the revision to a comparison page that shows a diff of what changed since the last deploy.

text: An API endpoint notifies Honeybadger when a deploy occurs
quote: Use this endpoint to notify Honeybadger when a deploy occurs.

text: Alarms pair a BadgerQL query with a threshold and trigger alerts when the result exceeds it
quote: Alarms combine a BadgerQL query (“count all slow requests in the past five minutes”) with a threshold (“when count is > 2”) and trigger alerts when the query result exceeds the threshold.

text: Anomaly detection alerts when a project's total error volume deviates statistically from its learned baseline
quote: Anomaly detection alerts you when a project’s total error volume deviates from its learned baseline... notifies you when the current rate is statistically unusual (for example, “errors are 4.7× your normal rate”).

text: You choose which error events result in a notification or ticket being created
quote: You get to choose which error events result in a notification or ticket being created

text: Integrates with PagerDuty through a Honeybadger service integration key
quote: You can generate an integration key for Honeybadger by logging in to PagerDuty then clicking on “Add New Service” and choosing “Honeybadger” as the service type.

text: Chat messages about errors include a button to resolve or reopen the error
quote: Messages about errors include a button to resolve or reopen the error

text: A chat command shows details about a specific fault by its number
quote:
**show fault _<fault #>_**

See details about the requested fault. The fault number can be found in the Honeybadger UI.

text: Issue exports to GitHub, GitLab, and Jira Cloud/Server can include full markdown or Jira wiki details
quote: We now support detailed issue exports to third-party managers. When enabled, your issue exports to GitHub or GitLab will contain the full markdown, or the full Jira wiki for JIRA Cloud and JIRA Server

text: Webhook integration supports a bearer token, enabling integrations with platforms like Cursor Automations
quote: Our Webhook integration has a new bearer token field. Now, users can integrate Honeybadger with platforms like Cursor Automations.

text: Outbound requests for source maps, webhooks, and uptime checks carry a secret Honeybadger-Token header for verification
quote: Requests sent from Honeybadger servers for source maps, web hooks, and uptime checks include the header Honeybadger-Token which is a secret token derived from your api key.

text: Official MCP server gives AI assistants project management, error investigation, and BadgerQL Insights queries
quote: Once connected, your AI assistant gains the following capabilities: Project management... Error investigation... Insights: Run BadgerQL queries against your event data.

text: Through MCP, agents can search errors, view occurrences and stack traces, see affected users, and analyze error patterns
quote: Error investigation: Search and filter errors, view occurrences and stack traces, see affected users, and analyze error patterns.

text: Through MCP, agents can list, create, update, and delete Insights dashboards
quote: Insights: Run BadgerQL queries against your event data. Dashboards: List, create, update, and delete Insights dashboards.

text: The hosted MCP server supports OAuth, so agents connect via browser approval instead of a pasted credential
quote: Our hosted MCP server supports OAuth, so you can connect an agent by approving access in your browser instead of copying and pasting a credential into a config file.

text: Errors can be reported by POSTing a JSON payload to the documented notices API, including from unsupported languages
quote: Your JSON payload should be submitted as the body of a POST request to https://api.honeybadger.io/v1/notices

text: A REST API returns a list of faults or a single fault for a project
quote: Returns a list of faults or a single fault for the given project

text: A REST API returns a list of projects or a single project
quote: Returns a list or a single project with the following format

text: JavaScript is un-minified automatically using source maps uploaded through the Source Map Upload API
quote: Honeybadger can automatically un-minify your JavaScript code if you provide a source map along with your minified files. Use the Source Map Upload API to upload your source maps to Honeybadger.

text: An official Honeybadger CLI provides command-line utilities
quote: The Honeybadger CLI provides a Command Line Interface for various Honeybadger-related programs and utilities.

text: The CLI can notify Honeybadger of a deployment
quote: `honeybadger deploy` Notify Honeybadger of deployment

text: The CLI can run a command and report the result to Honeybadger if it exits with a non-zero status
quote: honeybadger exec — Execute a command. If the exit status is not 0, report the result to Honeybadger

text: Oban integration reports unhandled worker exceptions and emits per-job telemetry to Insights
quote: Honeybadger now integrates with Oban (the Python port of the Elixir background job library). With this release you can report unhandled worker exceptions and emit per-job telemetry to Honeybadger Insights.

text: Python library automatically reports errors and telemetry
quote: Once installed, Honeybadger will automatically report errors and telemetry in your Python application.

text: JS packages automatically instrument HTTP requests, with options for event correlation, event context, and handlers
quote: Capture HTTP requests with automatic instrumentation and take advantage of new configuration options for event correlation, event context, handlers, and more with the updates for our JS packages.

text: Configuration options can tag and sort the clickable elements on a webpage that you care about
quote: Honeybadger now supports configuration options to tag and sort the clickable elements on a webpage that you care about.

text: SAML assertion attributes can map existing roles and teams into Honeybadger projects
quote: We added support for SAML assertion attributes, making team management even easier. Now, you can map already-existing roles and teams directly into your Honeybadger project.

text: Business and Enterprise accounts can replicate Insights data to keep it longer than Honeybadger stores it
quote: If you need to keep your Insights data longer than Honeybadger stores it, Business and Enterprise accounts can now replicate

text: Check-ins track pings from scheduled tasks and cron jobs
quote: Check-ins Tracking pings from scheduled tasks and cron jobs

text: Uptime monitoring notifies you when your API or website becomes unresponsive
quote: Uptime monitoring Get notified when your API and website are unresponsive

text: Status pages give users insight into your system status
quote: Status pages: Give users insight into your system status

text: Combines error tracking, uptime monitoring, logging, and application performance insights in one platform
quote: Honeybadger provides error tracking, uptime monitoring, logging, and application performance insights in one simple platform

text: Multiple accounts can be created and switched between from the navigation bar
quote: You can create additional accounts and switch between accounts using the dropdown in the navigation bar.

text: A free plan for solo developers covers web app monitoring
quote: Everything you need to monitor your web apps — for free, forever. Built for solo developers
